dependencies.name: base64
dependencies.role: bounded decoding of binary Chrome DevTools Protocol response bodies and screenshots
dependencies.rationale: CDP exposes binary bodies as Base64 text; the small standard-alphabet decoder is used only after response and message ceilings are enforced, while a custom decoder would add security-sensitive parsing without improving the capture contract.

dependencies.name: cbindgen
dependencies.role: pinned generation and drift verification for the experimental C header
dependencies.rationale: cbindgen derives C-compatible types and function declarations from the reviewed Rust ABI while a small checked-in configuration owns profile constants and header policy; exact regeneration closes declaration drift without claiming ABI stability or introducing handwritten parser logic.

dependencies.name: ciborium
dependencies.role: deterministic CBOR value encoding and decoding
dependencies.rationale: Its serde data-model bridge supports the profile's bounded generic value validation; canonical ordering remains NUIF-owned.

dependencies.name: criterion
dependencies.role: controlled-hardware statistical benchmarks
dependencies.rationale: Criterion provides saved-baseline comparison and throughput statistics while the portable smoke profile supplies cross-platform allocation evidence.

dependencies.name: font-test-data
dependencies.role: pinned accepted and rejected OpenType conformance fixtures
dependencies.rationale: A version-pinned permissively licensed corpus supplies exact Ahem shaping bytes plus static, collection, CFF, variable, color and bitmap resource fixtures without host font discovery.

dependencies.name: harfrust
dependencies.role: OpenType shaping
dependencies.rationale: Harfrust is the maintained HarfBuzz-project Rust shaper and keeps the reference path memory-safe and cross-platform.

dependencies.name: json5
dependencies.role: human-authored NUIF text parsing
dependencies.rationale: The authored syntax deliberately permits JSON5 while canonical emission is NUIF-owned; replacing it would change accepted source syntax.

dependencies.name: masonry
dependencies.role: native retained widget toolkit
dependencies.rationale: Masonry best matches the retained semantic test harness, but NUIF pins a reviewed refpath branch for the wgpu and font-stack corrections.

dependencies.name: masonry_testing
dependencies.role: native editor semantic and visual harness
dependencies.rationale: It drives the same widget tree and exposes accessibility plus deterministic CPU-render evidence; it is revision-locked with Masonry.

dependencies.name: masonry_winit
dependencies.role: native window and GPU event-loop backend
dependencies.rationale: The backend keeps widget, accessibility, window, and renderer versions coherent; the pinned branch removes obsolete Metal and font dependencies.

dependencies.name: nv-flip
dependencies.role: test-only LDR-FLIP perceptual error-map oracle for rendered-image diagnostics
dependencies.rationale: The exact Rust wrapper is already exercised by Vello, embeds NVIDIA's BSD-3-Clause CPU implementation and exposes the required PPD plus error map without a runtime Python/model dependency. NUIF pins both resolved crate versions, records PPD/input handling in every result and keeps exact pixels, elements and geometry authoritative because FLIP pooling is non-normative and platform-sensitive.

dependencies.name: png
dependencies.role: deterministic PNG artifact encoding
dependencies.rationale: The focused encoder avoids a broad image dependency and keeps decoded RGBA, rather than encoder bytes, as the render conformance boundary.

dependencies.name: rmcp
dependencies.role: current Model Context Protocol types, tool schemas, lifecycle, and stdio server routing
dependencies.rationale: The official Rust SDK tracks the breaking 2026-07-28 stateless lifecycle and conformance suite while calling NUIF's Rust core in-process; exact pinning and an executable wire oracle contain protocol churn without duplicating semantic operations or adding a second language process.

dependencies.name: rfd
dependencies.role: native open and save dialogs
dependencies.rationale: It supplies one small cross-platform dialog boundary; the editor keeps all parsing and writes outside the dialog crate and can replace it independently.

dependencies.name: roxmltree
dependencies.role: bounded SVG XML tree parsing with source ranges
dependencies.rationale: The retentive SVG profile needs read-only nodes and byte correspondence; normalizing SVG engines lose authored source and streaming parsers complicate span ownership.

dependencies.name: serde
dependencies.role: typed model serialization boundary
dependencies.rationale: Serde separates the typed model from the independently constrained text and CBOR encoders without imposing a wire format.

dependencies.name: serde_bytes
dependencies.role: explicit byte-string representation
dependencies.rationale: It preserves the distinction between binary payloads and numeric arrays across serde-backed formats.

dependencies.name: serde_json
dependencies.role: strict JSON artifacts, reports, and raw extension retention
dependencies.rationale: Raw-value support is more important than parser peak throughput for reports and opaque JSON retention; hostile inputs are bounded before parsing.

dependencies.name: serde-saphyr
dependencies.role: bounded typed YAML frontmatter parsing
dependencies.rationale: The documentation compiler needs deserialization only, duplicate-key rejection and parser budgets; serde-saphyr supplies those controls without the deprecated serde_yaml codebase or an unsafe LibYAML binding.

dependencies.name: sha2
dependencies.role: portable canonical and artifact hashes
dependencies.rationale: SHA-256 is interoperable with release tooling, web standards, and independent implementations; hashing is not a measured bottleneck.

dependencies.name: skrifa
dependencies.role: safe OpenType metadata, character maps, outlines, and variations
dependencies.rationale: Skrifa is the maintained Fontations parser used for the package-font metadata path and reference outlines. NUIF retains independent sfnt, checksum and OS/2 validation around it, while a pinned HarfBuzz capture supplies external metadata evidence after ttf-parser was retired for RUSTSEC-2026-0192.

dependencies.name: stats_alloc
dependencies.role: portable allocation smoke measurements
dependencies.rationale: It provides stable in-process allocation counts on every supported CI platform; deeper profilers remain diagnostic tools.

dependencies.name: taffy
dependencies.role: independent layout differential oracle
dependencies.rationale: Taffy is intentionally test-only so the NUIF layout implementation does not validate itself; browser and Taffy results are classified rather than blindly copied.

dependencies.name: tempfile
dependencies.role: isolated automatically cleaned browser profile directories for live capture
dependencies.rationale: Every capture must start without ambient cookies, storage, extensions or cache and must clean up after error paths; a scoped temporary directory provides that lifecycle without importing host profile state.

dependencies.name: thiserror
dependencies.role: typed library error definitions
dependencies.rationale: Typed public errors are part of adapter and conformance behavior; an opaque application error stack would weaken machine classification.

dependencies.name: tracing
dependencies.role: structured native editor diagnostics
dependencies.rationale: It matches the Masonry stack and keeps diagnostics structured without affecting canonical output.

dependencies.name: tree-sitter
dependencies.role: error-tolerant concrete syntax trees with byte ranges
dependencies.rationale: Retentive synchronization needs concrete byte ranges and partial-tree recovery rather than a normalized DOM alone.

dependencies.name: tree-sitter-css
dependencies.role: CSS concrete syntax grammar
dependencies.rationale: The grammar shares Tree-sitter's byte-range model, allowing CSS edits to use the same correspondence contract as HTML.

dependencies.name: tree-sitter-html
dependencies.role: HTML concrete syntax grammar
dependencies.rationale: The declared profile owns simple static source and byte-local edits; full HTML error correction is explicitly outside that profile.

dependencies.name: tree-sitter-javascript
dependencies.role: concrete JavaScript and JSX syntax grammar for the bounded React source adapter
dependencies.rationale: The adapter needs retained UTF-8 byte ranges and syntax recovery but must not evaluate JavaScript; sharing the Tree-sitter correspondence boundary avoids an AST normalization layer while the profile rejects dynamic constructs explicitly.

dependencies.name: tree-sitter-svelte-next
dependencies.role: concrete Svelte syntax grammar for the bounded static source adapter
dependencies.rationale: The adapter needs small in-process UTF-8 spans and structural exclusion of Svelte expressions, blocks, directives, scripts and styles; the exact official compiler remains the independent test oracle instead of becoming a JavaScript production sidecar.

dependencies.name: tokio
dependencies.role: single-thread async runtime and standard-I/O primitives for the MCP process shell
dependencies.rationale: rmcp is built on Tokio and the adapter needs only its current-thread runtime and stdio primitives; another runtime would add an interop layer, while a manual loop would duplicate official lifecycle and cancellation behavior.

dependencies.name: tungstenite
dependencies.role: bounded synchronous loopback WebSocket transport for the pinned Chromium capture adapter
dependencies.rationale: The capture process already owns an exact Chrome for Testing build and needs a sequential loopback CDP message channel, not another browser downloader, asynchronous runtime or automation object model. Exact 0.29 supplies RFC 6455 framing with explicit frame/message ceilings and no TLS feature for the loopback-only debugger socket. The reviewed 0.30 delta is a server-side client-key rejection plus dependency/MSRV updates; NUIF is only a client here, and 0.29 avoids four parallel Digest-family version lines. All CDP semantics and evidence limits remain NUIF-owned.

dependencies.name: wasm-bindgen
dependencies.role: typed byte-oriented JavaScript and WebAssembly ABI generation
dependencies.rationale: Current browser and Figma-style iframe consumers need generated JavaScript and TypeScript bindings today; keeping canonical documents and patches as byte arrays makes the binding thin and leaves a future WIT component surface possible without mirroring the model in JavaScript.

dependencies.name: zip
dependencies.role: bounded Penpot package container reading and deterministic writing
dependencies.rationale: The synchronous adapter needs member limits, duplicate-name checks, compression-method retention and deterministic metadata without an async runtime; NUIF owns those package policies around the maintained zip-rs implementation.

dependencies.name: zune-png
dependencies.role: independent PNG RGBA8 differential decoder
dependencies.rationale: The test-only decoder has separately implemented PNG logic, safe options and explicit CRC/Adler controls; keeping it out of the production decoder preserves a meaningful cross-library oracle.

dependencies.name: zeno
dependencies.role: deterministic CPU glyph mask rasterization
dependencies.rationale: The reference renderer needs a small exact CPU mask path; Vello remains the interactive renderer and is not the normative raster oracle.
